image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a red lionfish (Pterois volitans) resting on a textured, rocky reef substrate. The fish displays its characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes. Its large, fan-like pectoral fins are spread wide, showing elongated rays. The dorsal spines are prominent and fanned out. The head is large with visible eyes and mouth structures. The background consists of blurred coral or rock formations.
